method: Serialized stage dependency and17 original-camera comparison; six actual TerrainData anchor samples; actual imported water vertices checked against corrected native ground and closed opaque LOD0 rocks using odd/even backface ray parity in three directions. Excludes the first/last2% of curtain length and outer4% width for intentional joins. Translation rebase tested twice then restored, canonical meadow object and first-placement matrix unchanged. All tests use review proxies, not gameplay character animation.
limitations: No fluid simulation or arbitrary transparent sorting. Samples test curtain core points, not an exhaustive triangle/triangle Boolean proof. Final lighting, real combat transitions and Windows player performance remain WP08/WP09.
